prompt:
Flat sumi-e ink wash painting on aged warm paper. Hand-painted, not rendered. A single isolated subject on plain paper, centred, whole subject in frame. Dark tapering brush outline, flat even ink-wash fill, uniform ambient tone with no visible light source, no cast shadow, no sheen. Monochromatic warm grey from pale paper to near-black ink. Brush character at every edge.

Subject: one torii shrine gate like the ones in the reference image, redrawn alone, seen from slightly to one side (a shallow three-quarter view) so that its thickness shows. Two tall round posts standing straight. A long curved top lintel with gently upturned ends resting on a second, thinner beam directly under it. Lower down, a straight tie beam passing through both posts, with one short strut at the centre between the tie beam and the lintel. Every part of the gate is the same single flat vermilion red (#e34234), the only colour in the picture, with a dark tapering brush outline. No black cap, no plinth, no stone base: the posts simply end.

Plain empty paper background and nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no cliff wall, no mist, no clouds, no shadow, no text, no seal. Whole subject in frame with a paper margin all round.
